fix(deploy): upload to fgs-games bucket, not fas-apps

deploy.yml synced ./web/dist to s3://fas-apps/... but the host Worker
serves from the fgs-games bucket, so this game never appeared live
(uploaded bytes went to the FAS bucket the host doesn't read). Swap to
s3://fgs-games/games/<repo>/ to match host/wrangler.toml. Matches the
canonical template + fixed fgs-cli generator.

serves the 2026-05-21 build, so the topbar/selection/zoom fixes never
shipped. Regenerating the lockfile unblocks the pipeline.

Fix mobile layout: board could get pushed off-screen by dock content

On real phones the bottom status dock (full status text + New Game
button, ~360px tall) left too little vertical room for the aspect-
square board, which doesn't shrink on its own — rows 2-3 ended up
clipped past the viewport (reported via screenshot from the team).

- Board width is now capped by min(100%, 24rem, 58vh) via inline
  style (Tailwind's arbitrary min() with mixed units wasn't applying
  reliably), so the board always shrinks to fit available height
  instead of overflowing it.
- Added a compact mode to GameControls/ControlPanel for the mobile
  dock: single-line status + inline New Game button instead of the
  full paragraph explanation (still available via the topbar's rules
  info icon), cutting dock height from ~360px to ~80px.

Verified by measuring actual layout (getBoundingClientRect) at 390x844,
390x600, and a stress case of 375x500 — board and dock both fit with
zero overflow at every size, board sizes back up normally once height
isn't the binding constraint.

Restructure as a proper FreeGameStore game (was FreeAppStore-templated)

This repo was built to FreeAppStore conventions (fas), but the live
subdomain is served by FreeGameStore's R2-based Path B hosting, which
requires its own deploy pipeline and SDK. Nothing here ever matched
that, so the live site was stuck showing an unrelated placeholder.

  to main actually build and upload web/dist to the fgs-games R2
  bucket, matching freegamestore-online/template-game-grid.

  (turn/open-cell stats, rules overlay, about panel, restart, mute).

- Fix HTML viewport (user-scalable=no), PWA workbox caching (font
  runtime caching, raised precache size cap, .json in globPatterns),

winner, removing the single globally-oldest piece and freeing a cell.

onlyBuiltDependencies) and updates the decay countdown/expiring-cell

Fix shift-scene crash: KaPlay parses [G]/[C]/[H]/[Type it!] as unclosed style tags

The category button labels ("GUM\n[G]") and the STOP button ("STOP\n[Type it!]")
in the shift scene passed literal square brackets to k.text(). KaPlay treats
[name]…[/name] as styled-text markup, so these unclosed tags threw
"Styled text error: unclosed tags G" the instant a shift started — the game
booted to the morning screen (all the CI smoke test loads) but crashed on play.
Replace the brackets with parens; key hints read the same.
